message.content:
**ServiceNow, Inc. (CIK 1373715) — Operating expense profile, FY2024 vs. FY2023**

The company's operating expense base grew in absolute dollars but shrank as a share of revenue, i.e., the expense profile improved through operating leverage.

**Total operating expenses** (us-gaap:OperatingExpenses, USD, full-year FY ended Dec 31):
- FY2024: $7,333 million (fact id 1345358, accession 0001373715-25-000010, filed 2025-01-30)
- FY2023: $6,288 million (fact id 1345349, same accession; also 1345348 in 0001373715-24-000030)
- Growth: +16.6% (calculated), versus revenue growth of +22.4% ($10,984M vs. $8,971M; fact ids 1349417 / 1349408).
- Operating expenses as a share of revenue: 66.8% in FY2024 vs. 70.1% in FY2023 — a decline of about 3.3 percentage points (calculated). Operating income rose from $762M to $1,364M (fact ids 1345526 / 1345535).

**Component mix** (all USD, FY2024 vs. FY2023, same accession 0001373715-25-000010):

| Line | FY2024 | FY2023 | Growth | % of revenue FY24 vs FY23 (pp change) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cost of revenue | $2,287M (id 1338255) | $1,921M (id 1338246) | +19.1% | 20.8% vs 21.4% (−0.6 pp) |
| R&D | $2,543M (id 1349129) | $2,124M (id 1349120) | +19.7% | 23.2% vs 23.7% (−0.5 pp) |
| Sales & marketing | $3,854M (id 1349897) | $3,301M (id 1349888) | +16.8% | 35.1% vs 36.8% (−1.7 pp) |
| G&A | $936M (id 1341237) | $863M (id 1341228) | +8.5% | 8.5% vs 9.6% (−1.1 pp) |

(Percentage-point changes are my calculations from the cited facts; the four components sum to the reported total in both years.)

**What drove the change (management's explanation, FY2024 10-K, MD&A):**
- Sales & marketing rose $553M, "primarily due to increased headcount resulting in an increase in personnel-related costs including stock-based compensation and overhead expenses of $330 million," plus $90M more amortization of deferred commissions and $95M more program/branding/travel costs (chunk 1373715/now-20241231:187453).
- Cost of subscription revenues rose $336M, mainly headcount and data-center capacity costs (chunk 1373715/now-20241231:184691).
- Management expects S&M to "decrease slightly as a percentage of revenue" and G&A to "remain relatively flat as a percentage of revenue" in 2025, citing sales productivity, marketing efficiencies and G&A productivity (chunks 1373715/now-20241231:188276 and :190849) — these are forward-looking statements, not realized results.

**Summary:** Every major expense line grew in dollars, but all four grew more slowly than revenue, so each declined as a percentage of revenue. The largest leverage came from sales & marketing (−1.7 pp) and G&A (−1.1 pp), while R&D and cost of revenue were roughly stable in mix terms. The absolute-dollar growth was concentrated in personnel/headcount-related costs.

*Note: figures are as reported in the FY2024 10-K; FY2023 comparatives in that filing match the prior-year 10-K, so no revision issue arose. All values are raw USD, not scaled.*
